fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Domeggook Open API key (openapi.domeggook.com > API 키 발급/관리), sent as the `aid` query parameter. The same key serves 도매꾹 and 도매매.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe runs a one-item 도매꾹 (Domeggook) search. An invalid key answers HTTP 200 with {errors{code: 401, dcode: UNAUTHORIZED}}, reported as a tool error.

list_products.note: getItemList v4.1 on 도매꾹 (Domeggook) (market=dome): items on sale only. Domeggook requires at least one condition: `query` (kw) or `category` (ca, five two-digit pairs such as 01_11_00_00_00; a top-level-only code is not searchable). Prices are KRW integers; unitQty is the minimum order quantity. Errors arrive as HTTP 200 {errors{code, message, dcode, dmessage}} and are reported as tool errors.

get_product.note: getItemView v4.6: basis{no, status, title, dateReg}, price, qty{inventory, domeMoq, domeUnit}, deli (shipping rules), seller info and options in `raw`. price.dome is an integer, or a tier string such as "1+3800|20+3500|50+3300" (quantity+unit price), so it is returned as `dome_price` instead of the numeric `price`.

not_offered.quote_shipping: No shipping-rate call: shipping rules are part of the product record (deli.method, deli.pay, deli.dome{type, fee, tbl} quantity tables, see get_product), not quoted per destination.
not_offered.create_order: Ordering (주문서 생성) is a Private API: 'Private API는 권한 신청 및 승인 후 사용할 수 있습니다' and needs a setLogin session (member id/password, client ip, device 'Third Party' -> sId, https://openapi.domeggook.com/ko/articles/%EB%A1%9C%EA%B7%B8%EC%9D%B8-e4aaf7c2); not mapped for this Open-API key adapter.
not_offered.get_order: Order lookup (구매 주문서 상세 조회) is a Private API requiring approval and a setLogin session id (sId); not mapped for this Open-API key adapter.
not_offered.track: Delivery information is part of the Private API purchase-order record (approval + setLogin session required); not mapped.
